notes.title: Announcing the Release Date for Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi for June 16th!
notes.content:
To all our cherished players who adore the tranquility of fishing and the charm of leisurely moments,

We are absolutely thrilled to share some incredibly exciting news! Your eagerly awaited idle fishing game, **Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi, is officially launching on [b]June 16th at 7:00 PM (PDT)[/b]**! Are you ready to embark on a delightfully relaxing deep-sea fishing adventure right from the corner of your desktop?

To celebrate the grand debut of *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi*, we are delighted to offer a **[b]10% launch discount for a limited period of 14 days[/b]**! This is a wonderful opportunity to immerse yourself in the joy of fishing under serene blue skies, all at an even more delightful price.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399960/_/

[hr][/hr]

[b]**Exciting Collaborations: Collect Them All!**[/b]
We understand that perhaps just "fishing" isn't quite enough; your desktop deserves a vibrant array of captivating "creatures" and engaging experiences! That's why *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi* will be featuring enchanting collaborations with other beloved idle games. Soon, you'll be able to grab bundled packages, giving you immediate access to multiple desktop idle masterpieces and filling your screen with endless possibilities!

As for which games these are? We'll be revealing them simultaneously on launch day!


What's more, you'll discover familiar faces from other games making special appearances within *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi*! Imagine taking your favorite characters along for a fishing trip! Here's a little whispered preview:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527500/_MiSide/]**MiSide[/url] 
Let's imagine that you have a game in which you care for a character. But could you imagine one day getting into that game yourself?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427700/_Backpack_Battles/]**Backpack Battles[/url]
A PvP inventory management auto battler! Buy and craft powerful items, then carefully arrange them in your backpack.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296610/_Peglin/]**Peglin[/url]
Peglin is a Pachinko Roguelike - Fight enemies by collecting special orbs and popping pegs to deal damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537694/17c43838f68c7ae4aa4990747e584aa71a2a26c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537694/69c6c943acc74c1c2b804cf43d836ad332f4ce18.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[b]What's that? You still haven't heard of *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi*?[/b]
In essence, it's a wonderfully relaxing idle fishing game designed to seamlessly blend into your desktop corner. All you need to do is:

[list]
[*] Place it on your desktop** and watch your little fishing boat automatically venture out to sea, returning laden with treasures.
[*] Explore mysterious waters** and reel in all sorts of wonderfully whimsical marine creatures (yes, even rubber duckies!).
[*] Transform your catches** into delectable sushi and serve them to your charming (and perhaps a little peckish) customers.
[*] Upgrade your rods and bait** to hook more rare fish and fill your fish tank to the brim!
[/list]

This game is crafted to offer you a tranquil escape, a moment of "fishing" serenity and satisfaction amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life. Imagine glancing over during a busy workday and discovering you've just reeled in a giant tuna—doesn't that just brighten your day instantly?

Be sure to **add *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi* to your wishlist** so you won't miss our release announcement!

We look forward to seeing you there, as we embark on a new era of desktop tranquility together!

The *Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi* Development Team"

notes.title: 🎣 Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi - Demo Available Now! 🍣
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow fishing enthusiasts and fans of relaxing games!

We're excited to announce that the demo for our relaxing idle fishing game, Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi, is available now!

Do you yearn for a moment of tranquility amidst your busy life? Do you dream of the serene expanse of the blue sea? Then, Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi is the perfect escape for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399960/_/

🎣 Fish at Your Leisure, Anytime, Anywhere:

Whether you have a spare moment at work or during your commute, you can dive into the soothing world of Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi. The game can be conveniently placed in any corner of your screen, allowing you to unwind with some fishing while multitasking.

🐟 Explore a Wonderful Ocean:

Embark on a journey as a free-spirited angler, setting sail to discover a mysterious and vast ocean teeming with unique marine life just waiting to be caught!

🍣 Craft Delectable Sushi:

Transform your hard-earned catches into mouthwatering sushi creations, satisfying the palates of a diverse cast of customers. By selling your culinary delights, you'll earn valuable coins to further expand your fishing endeavors.

⏫ Upgrade Your Gear, Unlock More:

Continuously upgrade your fishing rod and unlock advanced bait to venture into deeper waters and reel in even rarer species. The ocean's secrets are boundless, waiting for you to uncover them!

🐠 Create Your Dream Aquarium:

House your prized collection of marine creatures in your very own personalized aquarium. Watch them gracefully swim and craft a unique underwater sanctuary!

We eagerly await your feedback and suggestions on the Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi demo during . Your support fuels our passion!

Thank you for your support! Let's embark on a relaxing fishing adventure together in the world of Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi!
